_README: Template for the Japanese discography. Copy this to data/discography-jp.json,
delete the _README and _FIELDS keys, and fill in the albums array.
Anything you leave out is fine — the page degrades gracefully.
Validate before committing:  python3 -m json.tool data/discography-jp.json

_FIELDS.release.id: REQUIRED. kebab-case, unique, used in the #deep-link. e.g. bdz
_FIELDS.release.title: REQUIRED. As it should display.
_FIELDS.release.artist: OPTIONAL. Only for collaborations — the other act. Shown on the card.
_FIELDS.release.seq: Free text under the type badge. e.g. '1st Japanese Album', 'Single'.
_FIELDS.release.type: REQUIRED. One of: EP | Full Album | Single | Reissue
_FIELDS.release.released: REQUIRED. YYYY-MM-DD preferred. YYYY-MM or YYYY also work and
_FIELDS.release.released2: display as 'Jul 2018' / '2018'. Partial dates sort last in their year.
_FIELDS.release.cover: Path to square art, e.g. assets/img/covers/bdz.jpg. Leave "" for a placeholder.
_FIELDS.release.note: OPTIONAL. One line shown under the title in the panel.
_FIELDS.release.links: Streaming URLs. Leave "" for any you don't have — it renders greyed out.
_FIELDS.track.title: REQUIRED.
_FIELDS.track.titleKo: OPTIONAL. Original-script title — use it for the Japanese title.
_FIELDS.track.artist: OPTIONAL. Solo / sub-unit / featured credit. Searchable.
_FIELDS.track.titleTrack: OPTIONAL. true adds the TITLE flag.
_FIELDS.video.kind: REQUIRED. One of: mv | lyric | performance | dance | live | audio | other
_FIELDS.video.url: REQUIRED. Full YouTube URL, youtu.be, /shorts/, or the bare 11-char id.
_FIELDS.video.url2: Non-YouTube links work too — they become link-out cards.
_FIELDS.video.official: true = green Official, false = amber Fan. Omitted means official.
_FIELDS.video.label: OPTIONAL. Overrides the caption, e.g. 'Dance Practice Video'.
